nodes.name: krizaka-coming-soon
nodes.description: The coming-soon pages of the Krizaka products' commercial domains: one static page per product, built from @krizaka/org.

nodes.name: krizaka-billing
nodes.description: Credits, wallets, plans, subscriptions, pricebook and metering (hold → settle → release) as a reusable billing service, with its contract (billing-api) and a typed HTTP client (billing-client).

nodes.name: krizaka-bom
nodes.description: Bill of materials of the Krizaka JVM artifacts: import it once and every com.krizaka dependency resolves to one coherent release.

nodes.name: krizaka-parent
nodes.description: Parent POM of every Krizaka JVM artifact: Maven Central metadata, Java 21 build conventions (formatting, tests, coverage, enforcer) and the signed release to Maven Central.

nodes.name: krizaka-payments
nodes.description: Payments for Java: the same port as @krizaka/payments (products and prices synced by lookup key, Checkout, customer portal, one verified and idempotent webhook), vendor-free; the Stripe adapter over the official stripe-java SDK is the only code that names the vendor. Money in long cents, clock injected, configuration passed in.

nodes.name: krizaka-quality
nodes.description: The PMD ruleset and the SpotBugs filter every Krizaka Java build applies in verify: the local twin of the Sonar Java findings we actually have (ADR-013).

nodes.name: krizaka-rewrite-style
nodes.description: The Java code style OpenRewrite applies in every Krizaka repository, so that it never autodetects one: imports are never folded into a star import, static imports first (the layout google-java-format writes).

nodes.name: krizaka-service-kit
nodes.description: Cross-cutting building blocks for Spring Boot services: stateless JWT security with one baseline, service-to-service tokens, idempotent message consumption, a transactional outbox relay and the HTTP baseline (Problem Details, request correlation, Jackson defaults, cursor pagination, declared CORS).

nodes.name: krizaka-test-support
nodes.description: Test kit of the Krizaka repositories, for test scope: generic ArchUnit code rules (hexagonal layering, one class per file, constructor injection, private state, unambiguous configuration binding), authorization rules (every @RestController endpoint must carry @PreAuthorize/@Secured/@RolesAllowed), source rules, the infra/initdb locator, MockMvc authorization assertions (401/403/404), and Testcontainers helpers: shared PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ containers for integration tests, and the database role of services that own one.

nodes.name: krizaka-users
nodes.description: Reusable user management for any Krizaka application: registration, e-mail verification, login (password + Google/GitHub OAuth), forgot/reset password, profile & preferences, API keys, RBAC and JWT issuance.

repos.name: krizaka-lab
repos.role: The family lab: UI, motion, Java, AI and data experiments; publishes nothing (formerly krizaka-motion)

nodes.name: krizaka-lab
nodes.description: Krizaka Lab, the family's lab for UI, motion, Java, AI and data experiments. Not a product and not a package: nothing is published or imported from it.

nodes.name: @krizaka/api-keys
nodes.description: API keys for every Krizaka product: created, rotated, revoked and authenticated behind a store port. The key is shown once, only a hash of its random part is kept, scopes and rules are data, refusals have stable codes. No framework, no database client, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/architecture
nodes.description: The C4 view of a repository, generated from its code and manifests: containers from the workspaces (with their version and the org dependencies that build them, from the lockfile), Maven modules, crates and Python projects, components from the folders, the imports between them, the external services from the env declarations. Runs on a local checkout or a map of files, writes JSON and a text version.

nodes.name: @krizaka/audit
nodes.description: Who did what, for every Krizaka product: an append-only audit trail in its own schema, written inside the caller's transaction or quietly beside it, filtered for the admin, exported and redacted for Loi 25, purged after a retention set by the admin. No database client, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/auth
nodes.description: The account of a Krizaka product — name, language, theme, avatar, e-mail change by link with the verified flag, password, sessions with sign-out of the others, data export, deletion — behind a port, with a PostgreSQL adapter and its migration. Each product keeps its own accounts; no framework, no wall clock, no mail vendor.

nodes.name: @krizaka/brief
nodes.description: A Krizaka product's weekly brief: a few figured recommendations, each with one action. The contract (integer money, named figures, evidence, assumptions), guards that veto with a reason, a deterministic ranking that keeps the top three, and the week in the shop's time zone. Pure: no framework, no database, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/config
nodes.description: The shared configuration of every Krizaka JavaScript repository: ESLint flat configs (base, Next.js, the four UI rules, the stack rules, no locale ternary), the « Krizaka first » covered-domains map and the dependency-cruiser preset generated from it (refused imports, cycles, unresolvable imports, dev dependencies), tsconfig bases, Prettier, EditorConfig, the shared ast-grep rule pack (sets core, web, html) with the krizaka-sg-ratchet bin, the krizaka-seo-family check, the krizaka-edit-check hook for coding agents, the krizaka-workspace-guard (no registry range between packages of one pnpm workspace), the krizaka-hooks git hook chain, and the krizaka-ratchet and krizaka-known-violations debt counters.

nodes.name: @krizaka/contract
nodes.description: Declare a response contract once (zod) and assert it everywhere the answer is acted on: route tests, journeys, synthetic monitors and the fetch wrappers of runtime boundaries. A 204 with no body, a missing field, an undefined or NaN count, an empty string or an empty list where one is required all fail with the field's path, so « sent to undefined of undefined » can never pass.

nodes.name: @krizaka/coupons
nodes.description: Discount and credit coupons the admin manages, for every Krizaka product: a code with a window and limits, reserved at checkout under a row lock, confirmed once on the payment event, released when unpaid, refunded; partners for attribution. The database is the source of truth; the provider applies the discount from immutable terms; credit coupons grant capped credits. No database client, no wall clock, no network.

nodes.name: @krizaka/credits
nodes.description: One credits ledger for every Krizaka product: grants that expire with daily and monthly caps, purchases, debits, refunds, holds. Append-only; the balance is derived. Concurrent consumption never goes negative and never spends twice. No database client, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/db
nodes.description: The database foundation of every Krizaka module: shared Query, Connection and Clock types, transactions, versioned and frozen module schemas embedded in the product's own migration sequence, a runner for products without one, and a test database helper. No database client: the product passes its own connection.

nodes.name: @krizaka/email-verification
nodes.description: Proof that a person controls an e-mail address, for every Krizaka public form: a 6-digit code mailed to the address, valid 15 minutes, single use, a few attempts, kept only as a salted hash; the action it protects (a contact message, a subscription) is held and released only after the code is confirmed. EN and FR mail texts. No environment variable, no wall clock, no vendor.

nodes.name: @krizaka/mail
nodes.description: Mail for every Krizaka product: queued in the caller's transaction through the outbox, delivered once per idempotency key, never to a suppressed address (stored as a hash); providers (Mailgun, Resend, Mailpit, log); off production only an allowlist is mailed over an injected fetch; bounces and complaints from signed webhooks. No vendor SDK, no environment variable, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/notifications
nodes.description: The bell, channels and preferences for every Krizaka product: one notify() writes the in-app item and appends one outbox message per enabled channel (e-mail, push per device, live), respecting the account's matrix of categories by channels and per-category burst caps that hold under concurrency. The product declares its categories; the admin tunes defaults and caps. No push or realtime import, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/org
nodes.description: The public facts about Krizaka, in one validated JSON that every footer, site and app reads: legal name, NEQ, « Fait à Montréal » in French and English, brand marks, default avatars and banners, the live products and sites, the public contact, the footer line and the mobile apps' public runtime config. Typed data, JSON Schema, and the files published on the CDN.

nodes.name: @krizaka/organize
nodes.description: The « organize » block of every Krizaka product: a name, an avatar, a description, tags, collections and an undeletable default collection for any entity; and the workspace, organised — tags with colour markers, status sets as data, saved views and bulk actions, scoped to a workspace, audited. Rules, a store over PostgreSQL, a browser-safe contract and a conformance kit. No ORM, no framework: you pass a query function.

nodes.name: @krizaka/outbox
nodes.description: The transactional outbox of every Krizaka product: an event written in the caller's transaction, delivered after the commit at least once by leased workers, with doubling retries, dead letters and an idempotent-consumer helper. No broker, no database client, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/page-audit
nodes.description: The page audit of every Krizaka app, in one place: HTTP status, empty main, horizontal overflow, a card out of its panel, sections covering each other, a column cut off, top chrome overlaps, unnamed buttons, empty headings. Runs in a real browser (Playwright) over a route list, viewports and themes, with View Transitions neutralised and a self-test on its own fixtures.

nodes.name: @krizaka/payments
nodes.description: Payments for every Krizaka product, the processor behind a port: the Stripe adapter (Checkout with discount terms, expiry and idempotency, customer portal, price read by lookup key, verified webhook with paid, expired and refunded events), event application in the effect's transaction, announcement through the outbox, integer money, and a catalogue setup built from the price catalogue. No SDK: you pass fetch.

nodes.name: @krizaka/privacy
nodes.description: Privacy for every Krizaka product (Loi 25): consents by purpose written once with the notice version shown, an export assembled from every module that holds the person's data, an erasure that runs in one transaction and leaves a record without personal data, and retention per purpose set by the admin. A port each module implements; no database client, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/rate-limit
nodes.description: Limits per action for every Krizaka product: fixed windows per address and per subject, the limits read from the admin's settings, a memory store and a PostgreSQL store whose atomic upsert counts exactly under concurrency, a stable 429 with Retry-After. No database client, no wall clock, no request object.

nodes.name: @krizaka/settings
nodes.description: A Krizaka product's configuration as data: a typed registry (flags, integers, choices, subsets, bilingual texts), resolved user over workspace over global over default, changed by an administrator with an audit line for every change, the price catalogue (CAD, before taxes, availability, limits) in dated versions a subscription keeps, and the JSON-safe description an admin screen draws from. PostgreSQL adapter and migration included; no framework, no wall clock.

nodes.name: @krizaka/sovkora-client
nodes.description: One Sovkora client for the TypeScript products: start a Studio run (safe to retry with an idempotency key), read its status and outputs, wait for it, with typed errors with stable codes, a time limit and a circuit breaker. Base URL, key and clock are parameters; no environment, no framework.

nodes.name: @krizaka/storage
nodes.description: Files behind one port for every Krizaka product: put with a content-hashed name, get, head, delete, list, signed and public URLs; adapters over an injected fetch for an HTTP object store and any S3-compatible bucket (Signature V4, no SDK), and a local folder; layout as data, bytes checked by magic number, limits passed in. The admin chooses the provider through settings.

nodes.name: @krizaka/time
nodes.description: Date arithmetic for every Krizaka backend, in one place: add seconds, minutes and hours to an instant, measure the gap between two, compare them. Exact on the instant, whatever the server's time zone. The facade the « Krizaka first » dates rule points to, so no package imports a date library of its own.

nodes.name: @krizaka/video
nodes.description: Video behind one port: server-signed TUS uploads, embed and CDN playback tokens, HLS and poster URLs, webhook statuses with signature check; Bunny Stream as the first adapter. The client never holds a library key. No network in the package's own code beyond an injected fetch.

nodes.name: @krizaka/webhooks
nodes.description: Signed and idempotent webhooks, both ways, for every Krizaka product. Out: an owner registers endpoints, events are queued once per endpoint and delivered signed with retries and a delivery log. In: a body is verified (HMAC, timestamp tolerance) and applied exactly once. PostgreSQL adapter and migration; the HTTP call, the secret sealing and the clock are the product's.

nodes.name: @krizaka/config
nodes.description: The shared configuration of every Krizaka JavaScript repository: ESLint flat configs (base, Next.js, the four UI rules, the stack rules, no locale ternary), the « Krizaka first » covered-domains map and the dependency-cruiser preset generated from it (refused imports, cycles, unresolvable imports, dev dependencies), tsconfig bases, Prettier, EditorConfig, the shared ast-grep rule pack (sets core, web, html) with the krizaka-sg-ratchet bin, the krizaka-seo-family check, the krizaka-edit-check hook for coding agents, the krizaka-workspace-guard (no registry range between packages of one pnpm workspace), the krizaka-hooks git hook chain, and the krizaka-ratchet and krizaka-known-violations debt counters.

nodes.description: The public facts about Krizaka, in one validated JSON that every footer, site and app reads: legal name, NEQ, « Fait à Montréal » in French and English, brand marks, default avatars and banners, the live products and sites, the public contact, the footer line and the mobile apps' public runtime config. nodes.name: @krizaka/a11y-audit
nodes.description: The accessibility guard of every Krizaka product's page audit: axe-core (WCAG 2.1 AA) run on the pages a Playwright crawl already visits, in dark and light, and a ratchet — violations counted per rule in a baseline file, a new one fails, the count only goes down.

nodes.name: @krizaka/app-client
nodes.description: What every Krizaka Expo app shares: the bearer session over a secure-storage port, the discovery client of the signed services manifest, the API client (bearer, timeout, 401 handling) and, in ./react, the auth context every app's screens read. Ports in, no native module imported.

nodes.name: @krizaka/app-config
nodes.description: App version compatibility for Krizaka apps and backends: one contract (min/latest version, update mode, maintenance, contract range, 426 Upgrade Required, N-1 with Deprecation/Sunset) for Next.js backends and mobile, desktop and web clients. Twin of the Java building block krizaka-app-config. Zero dependency.

nodes.name: @krizaka/app-desktop
nodes.description: What every Krizaka Mac app (Tauri 2) calls on its native side, typed: folder grants and watched folders, dropped files, the Keychain as @krizaka/app-client's storage, the native menu bar, deep links and the update channel — over tauri-plugin-krizaka. Tauri is passed in, never imported.

nodes.name: @krizaka/charts
nodes.description: Krizaka's data visualisation: typed, declarative React charts (line, area, bar, pie, radar, heatmap, calendar, sankey, funnel, gauge, sparkline, candlestick, treemap, scatter, geo map, 3D globe) on the --kz-* tokens and the brand palettes — an accessible data table, a written summary and keyboard navigation in every chart, SSR without layout shift, and React Native for the simple types.

nodes.name: @krizaka/discovery
nodes.description: Service discovery for every Krizaka mobile app: load a signed manifest of backend addresses (Ed25519 over canonical JSON), allow-list the hosts, cache it, fall back cached → baked default → legacy host, and honour minimum version and maintenance — so a URL change never forces a store republish.

nodes.name: @krizaka/email
nodes.description: One email system for every Krizaka app: typed, branded, bilingual templates on React Email (email-safe HTML, a plain-text part always generated), brand themes from @krizaka/tokens, and a sendEmail() adapter with one-click unsubscribe headers, idempotency, a delivery log and bounce/complaint suppression.

nodes.name: @krizaka/fonts
nodes.description: The Krizaka typefaces, self-hosted: Young Serif (display), Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (text), Courier Prime (mono), plus Krizaka Cahier (a sparing handwritten pen, derived from Caveat) — WOFF2 subsets (latin, latin-ext) with metric-matched fallbacks for the web, static TrueType for React Native / Expo, SIL OFL 1.1.

nodes.name: @krizaka/i18n
nodes.description: The i18n engine of every Krizaka app: typed message keys and placeholders from en.json, format(), plurals through @krizaka/intl, <Rich> (<b>, <a>), a React provider, and the krizaka-i18n CLI that checks catalogues and finds hard-coded strings.

nodes.name: @krizaka/icons
nodes.description: The Krizaka signature icons: one drawing language (24 grid, cut corners, a node at the core) for every Krizaka product — React (tree-shakable, server-safe) and React Native (react-native-svg).

nodes.name: @krizaka/intl
nodes.description: Money, numbers, dates and plurals formatted the same way in every Krizaka product: zero dependency, built on Intl, money from integer minor units only.

nodes.name: @krizaka/pacer
nodes.description: Cadence for every Krizaka app: debounce and throttle (functions and React hooks), a job queue with concurrency, priority, retries with backoff, pause and resume per job, and a client rate limiter that learns from a server's Problem Details — TanStack Pacer (beta) behind the Krizaka facade.

nodes.name: @krizaka/push
nodes.description: Mobile push without an SDK: the Expo Push Service relays to FCM (Android) and APNs (iOS) from one HTTP call. Pure and dependency-free: batches by 100, never throws, reports the dead tokens to forget.

nodes.name: @krizaka/query
nodes.description: Server state for every Krizaka app: TanStack Query v5 with the Krizaka defaults, a typed fetch that reads RFC 9457 Problem Details, typed query keys, live invalidation from a realtime stream, App Router hydration and an offline persister for Expo.

nodes.name: @krizaka/realtime
nodes.description: Realtime for Node apps behind one interface: a bus (publish / subscribe by channel) and presence (who is connected, by heartbeat and TTL), with memory, PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY and Redis / Valkey adapters, plus Server-Sent Events framing.

nodes.name: @krizaka/site
nodes.description: ui.krizaka.com — the documentation of Krizaka UI, built from the workspace packages at every change: the code drives the docs. Static export, deployed on DigitalOcean App Platform.

nodes.name: @krizaka/sovkora-design-system
nodes.description: The Sovkora identity on the Krizaka platform: the Sovkora Orange theme (the Sovkora brand of @krizaka/tokens) and its named themes as --kz-* token overrides, the product composites (ChatShowcase, CommandPalette, SentinelMini, icon registry) with their documentation registry (krizaka.com/docs/sovkora/ui), and the @krizaka/ui primitives re-exported.

nodes.name: @krizaka/sovkora-shared
nodes.description: Sovkora shared contracts: TypeScript types, Zod schemas and design tokens (framework-agnostic).

nodes.name: @krizaka/storybook
nodes.description: The Krizaka platform's internal catalogue: every primitive of @krizaka/ui and every chart of @krizaka/charts in dark and light, under each product identity, checked for accessibility and visual regressions in CI. Not published — the public documentation is ui.krizaka.com.

nodes.name: @krizaka/tailwind
nodes.description: The Krizaka Tailwind CSS v4 preset: the semantic --kz-* tokens as utilities (bg-surface-1, text-fg-secondary, border-border-default, text-accent, rounded-xl…), illustration-only light/dark variants and the Krizaka easing.

nodes.name: @krizaka/tokens
nodes.description: The Krizaka semantic design tokens (--kz-*) and the brand themes (Krizaka, Sovkora, Verikora, Folioviv): one DTCG source compiled to CSS (dark, light, media invariants), typed constants and React Native themes.

nodes.name: @krizaka/ui
nodes.description: The Krizaka front-end platform's components: the primitives (button, card, dialog, toast, menu, field, tabs, chip, switch, slider, command palette, theme, countdown…) on the semantic --kz-* tokens, the animated marks (Krizaka, Sovkora, Verikora, Folioviv) and the motion signature — web and /native.

nodes.name: @krizaka/app-client
nodes.description: What every Krizaka Expo app shares: the bearer session over a secure-storage port, the discovery client of the signed services manifest, the API client (bearer, timeout, 401 handling) and, in ./react, the auth context every app's screens read. Ports in, no native module imported.

nodes.name: @krizaka/charts
nodes.description: Krizaka's data visualisation: typed, declarative React charts (line, area, bar, pie, radar, heatmap, calendar, sankey, funnel, gauge, sparkline, candlestick, treemap, scatter, geo map, 3D globe) on the --kz-* tokens and the brand palettes — an accessible data table, a written summary and keyboard navigation in every chart, SSR without layout shift, and React Native for the simple types.

nodes.name: @krizaka/discovery
nodes.description: Service discovery for every Krizaka mobile app: load a signed manifest of backend addresses (Ed25519 over canonical JSON), allow-list the hosts, cache it, fall back cached → baked default → legacy host, and honour minimum version and maintenance — so a URL change never forces a store republish.

nodes.name: @krizaka/fonts
nodes.description: The Krizaka typefaces, self-hosted: Young Serif (display), Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (text), Courier Prime (mono), plus Krizaka Cahier (a sparing handwritten pen, derived from Caveat) — WOFF2 subsets (latin, latin-ext) with metric-matched fallbacks for the web, static TrueType for React Native / Expo, SIL OFL 1.1.

nodes.name: @krizaka/i18n
nodes.description: The i18n engine of every Krizaka app: typed message keys and placeholders from en.json, format(), plurals through @krizaka/intl, <Rich> (<b>, <a>), a React provider, and the krizaka-i18n CLI that checks catalogues and finds hard-coded strings.

nodes.name: @krizaka/icons
nodes.description: The Krizaka signature icons: one drawing language (24 grid, cut corners, a node at the core) for every Krizaka product — React (tree-shakable, server-safe) and React Native (react-native-svg).

nodes.name: @krizaka/intl
nodes.description: Money, numbers, dates and plurals formatted the same way in every Krizaka product: zero dependency, built on Intl, money from integer minor units only.

nodes.name: @krizaka/pacer
nodes.description: Cadence for every Krizaka app: debounce and throttle (functions and React hooks), a job queue with concurrency, priority, retries with backoff, pause and resume per job, and a client rate limiter that learns from a server's Problem Details — TanStack Pacer (beta) behind the Krizaka facade.

nodes.name: @krizaka/query
nodes.description: Server state for every Krizaka app: TanStack Query v5 with the Krizaka defaults, a typed fetch that reads RFC 9457 Problem Details, typed query keys, live invalidation from a realtime stream, App Router hydration and an offline persister for Expo.

nodes.name: @krizaka/realtime
nodes.description: Realtime for Node apps behind one interface: a bus (publish / subscribe by channel) and presence (who is connected, by heartbeat and TTL), with memory, PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY and Redis / Valkey adapters, plus Server-Sent Events framing.

nodes.name: @krizaka/sovkora-shared
nodes.description: Sovkora shared contracts: TypeScript types, Zod schemas and design tokens (framework-agnostic).

nodes.name: @krizaka/tailwind
nodes.description: The Krizaka Tailwind CSS v4 preset: the semantic --kz-* tokens as utilities (bg-surface-1, text-fg-secondary, border-border-default, text-accent, rounded-xl…), illustration-only light/dark variants and the Krizaka easing.

nodes.title: GitHub
nodes.description: Code, issues, pull requests, CI, the merge queue and the tags.

nodes.title: Model providers
nodes.description: The AI models Sovkora routes to, local or hosted.

nodes.title: Automation service
nodes.description: Cloud automations: signed webhooks and schedules that start Studio runs, and their history.

nodes.title: Billing service
nodes.description: Plans, wallets, packs held and credit holds; a Krizaka Java building block run in the Sovkora core (meters, never blocks, in dev).

nodes.title: Message broker
nodes.description: The job, event and dead-letter exchanges; TLS only, private to the network.

nodes.title: Build and test support
nodes.description: The parent POM, the rewrite style and the test support of every Sovkora JVM repository.

nodes.title: CLI
nodes.description: Clone, install, start and develop the platform from a terminal, with an offline queue.

nodes.title: Contracts
nodes.description: The job and persistence contracts and the asset cryptography shared by the services.

nodes.title: Conversation service
nodes.description: Chat with token streaming (SSE), models, bootstrap features; runs the turn pipeline in-process.

nodes.title: Databases
nodes.description: One database and one role per context on the shared dev cluster.

nodes.title: Sovkora for Mac
nodes.description: Installer and control panel; gives Sovkora access to the folders the user picks, and runs local automations (ADR-079).

nodes.title: Edge service
nodes.description: The only public port: routes chat, sign-in, billing, Studios, automations and recommendations to the services.
nodes.technology: Java 21, Spring Boot 4, Spring MVC on virtual threads

nodes.title: Engine
nodes.description: The engine core: the turn pipeline, interceptors, business layer, tools and their adapters.

nodes.title: GPU host, by the hour
nodes.description: Runs the media worker and the local models (images, 9:16 video, speech, Studio text) only while started; guarded when idle.
nodes.technology: RunPod pod or GPU droplet; LocalAI, Ollama

nodes.title: Job service
nodes.description: Capability registry, the job lanes and the run saga; settles runs and hands work to the workers.

nodes.title: Kridoc client
nodes.description: Sovkora as a client of Kridoc, the business storage product: the sealed media, the uploads and the archived job files go through the Kridoc API (Kridoc-hosted in Canada, or the customer own storage), behind the existing DurableAssetStore port; a pack reads a customer document only through a consent grant. The databases stay Sovkora own.

nodes.title: Media worker
nodes.description: Image and video generation and media composition; on the GPU host, and as the hosted-video consumer in the core.

nodes.title: Mobile app
nodes.description: Chat and Studios on the phone.

nodes.title: Packs and pack workers
nodes.description: The reference packs and their manifest schema; the document-validation worker runs beside the services.

nodes.title: GPU relay
nodes.description: The tunnel server the GPU host dials out to; nothing on the GPU host is exposed.

nodes.title: Web search
nodes.description: Self-hosted search for grounded answers that cite their sources; dev only until its hosting and limits are validated.

nodes.title: Serverless GPU endpoint
nodes.description: Media jobs at zero idle cost, triggered from the job lanes; adopted only if cheaper per clip than the guarded pod.
nodes.technology: RunPod serverless, the media worker image

nodes.title: Studio service
nodes.description: Studios, packs installed at boot, and runs.

nodes.title: UI kit
nodes.description: The design system and shared code of the three apps (@krizaka/orazaka-design-system, @krizaka/orazaka-shared, on npm); folds into Krizaka UI (ADR-029), then its repository is deleted.

nodes.title: Users service
nodes.description: Sign-in, tokens and profiles; a Krizaka Java building block run in the Sovkora core (sign-up closed in dev).

nodes.title: Web app and console
nodes.description: The customer site (chat, Studios) and the operator console on the admin host, with its server routes (BFF).

nodes.title: Repository and delivery
nodes.description: The one repository (ADR-029): the module catalogue, the one CI, the dev image and deployment spec, and the end-to-end tests.
nodes.technology: Maven, pnpm, uv, Docker, App Platform spec
